I recently had a terrible experience staying at this Flat 118, Shreepati Wing C and would advise anyone considering booking it to look elsewhere. My stay was plagued by a number of issues that made the accommodation completely unsuitable for anyone.

In addition to this, the room lacked natural sunlight, which made it feel very claustrophobic and depressing. The limited amount of daylight that did filter in only highlighted the dinginess of the space.

Furthermore, the water supply was limited to just one hour per day, which made it extremely difficult to shower or carry out any basic hygiene practices. This was unacceptable and made my stay very unpleasant.

The owner of the flat (Mohan Thevar) was also terrible. He was rude, unresponsive and unhelpful when we raised concerns about the property. We immediately told him and he was saying "ye toh hote rehta hai". He didn't even returned our security deposit on time. He took 5k from it. The worst human alive on this planet, who only cares about money.

There is no mobile network coming in this flat.
Alot of time we missed important calls.

To top it all off, the building was infested with cockroaches and rats. The presence of these pests was disgusting and made the flat feel very unsanitary. I was constantly on edge and felt like I couldn't relax or enjoy my time there.

Overall, I would strongly advise anyone to avoid this flat at all costs. It was a terrible experience that I would never want to repeat.
